selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall permits SSH and TCP 8080 while rejecting unrelated inbound connections
selected_evidence.summary: Runtime and permanent public-zone configuration contains only SSH and TCP 8080, with a REJECT target. Effective nftables rules accept TCP 22/8080 and reject unmatched input.
Before and after reboot, TCP 8080 returned HTTP 200 through the public zone, while TCP 9090 was rejected even though a listener existed.

Healthy baseline boot ID 5b620f5a-2111-4f37-b111-4cdf414707cf was captured; the safe reboot was acknowledged; post-reboot boot ID changed to 6ad64e3b-90cb-4f32-82c0-9e4754da9d36. Firewalld and sshd recovered active/enabled, SSH was listening, and the persistent firewall policy and functional behavior recovered.
